The main takeaway from our work is that

the spermatheca of Ae. aegpyti is a highly dynamic organ, which requires the coordinated expression of a large number of genes to maintain its functions, such as the maintenance of sperm viability and the production of viable eggs.
the Ae. aegpyti spermathecal transcriptome has been identified and the role of several of its transcripts has been determined.
